landing_meta_title: Debt Master — Free, self-hosted team lunch debt tracker
landing_meta_description: Keep one honest ledger of your team's shared lunches. Admins log lunches and payments; colleagues check exactly what they owe. Free and open source.
landing_hero_subtitle: Debt Master keeps your team's shared lunch tab: who ate, what it cost, and exactly who owes what. No mental math, no awkward reminders.
landing_hero_proof: Free, open source, and self-hosted, so your team's numbers stay on your server.
landing_ledger_aria: Sample team ledger showing outstanding lunch debts
landing_faq_a1: A free, self-hosted web app that tracks shared lunch expenses in a workplace team.
landing_faq_a2: Teams that eat together: offices with a regular lunch crew, departments that rotate who picks up the bill, or any group that shares meal costs.
landing_faq_a3: Colleagues sign in with an access code issued by their admin; only admins need email and password.
landing_faq_a4: On your own server. Debt Master is self-hosted, so expenses, names, and balances never leave the machine you run it on.
landing_faq_a5: Nothing. Debt Master is open source under the MIT license, so you run it yourself for free.
landing_faq_a6: On the way — a separate Debt Master app for splitting expenses with friends, coming to iPhone and Android. The App page has the details.
landing_cta_appLink: Get the app for iPhone and Android
landing_code_caption: Colleagues sign in with an access code and see only their own tab.
landing_payments_caption: A balance clears only after the payment is confirmed.
landing_ranked_caption: Who owes the most, who is almost clear, at a glance.
app_landing_meta_title: Debt Master for iPhone & Android — split expenses with friends
app_landing_meta_description: One honest ledger per group: trips, roommates, lunch crews. Multi-currency balances, receipt scanning, and settle-ups both sides confirm. Free on iOS and Android.
app_landing_hero_subtitle: Debt Master keeps every group tab straight: who paid, who owes, and a settle-up both sides confirm. Trips, roommates, lunch crews — one honest ledger per group.
app_landing_hero_proof: Free to split. Pro adds unlimited groups, receipt photos, and OCR scanning.
app_landing_coming_soon: Coming soon to the App Store and Google Play.
app_landing_phone_aria: Phone preview of a Debt Master group ledger
app_landing_fx_caption: Log each expense in its own currency — yen for dinner, euros for the train — and balances roll up to one base currency for the group. No calculators, no screenshots.
app_landing_scan_caption: Snap the bill and OCR turns it into a split you can adjust — items, total, and tax, before the table clears. Pro scans 25 receipts a month; free tries one.
app_landing_confirm_caption: Recording a payment starts a handshake: the other side confirms receipt before the balance clears. No more “I paid you back” vanishing into the group chat.
app_landing_faq_q1: What is the Debt Master app?
app_landing_faq_a1: A mobile expense splitter for small groups — trips, roommates, lunch crews, clubs. Every group keeps its own ledger, and balances are one tap away.
app_landing_faq_a2: Splitting, balances, settlement, and statements are free. Debt Master Pro is $24.99 a year: unlimited groups, receipt photo storage, and 25 OCR scans a month.
app_landing_faq_q3: Do my friends need an account?
app_landing_faq_a3: No. Share an invite link and they join the group under their own name — no signup wall.
app_landing_faq_q4: Which phones does it run on?
app_landing_faq_a4: iPhone and Android. It's built for the table: log the expense while the bill is still on it.
app_landing_cross_link: Prefer to run it yourself? The web app is free, open source, and self-hosted.
